text: We often persuade ourselves to love people who are more powerful than we are, yet interest alone produces our friendship; we do not give our hearts away for the good we wish to do, but for that we expect to receive.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld
reference: Reflections; or Sentences and Moral Maxims
translation: J. W. Willis Bund and J. Hain Friswell, 1871
